Class TestExpressionValueLiterals

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.gametest.integration.TestExpressionValueLiterals
public class TestExpressionValueLiterals extends Object
Tests for how values that need the game's registries are written in the text form of expressions, and that each reads back into the same value.
